rationale: CFWF_CLAIMANT_FACTION_WAR_EFFECTS
P14.1_MISSING_EFFECT_SHIMS
base = AGOT 00_agot_dragon_effects.txt lines 2302-2675 VERBATIM (374 lines, 57 $PARAM$ tokens, single top-level key, brace balance 0)

CAUSE: AGOT More Dragon Eggs (3388366564) ships a full-file copy of AGOT 00_agot_dragon_effects.txt built against an older AGOT; its copy of agot_historical_dragon_transfer_vars_to_story_cycle_effect uses 44 $PARAM$ tokens vs AGOT's 57. The 13 it omits match the 13 named in the error.log failure exactly.

MECHANISM: scripted effects are database keys, last mod loaded wins. A stale definition takes the key while AGOT's 72 call sites still pass all 57 arguments; the compiler rejects the 13 it does not recognise and the effect never compiles.
SAFE IF IRRELEVANT: byte-identical to AGOT's own definition when nothing overrides it.

NOTE 2026-08-31: this did NOT fix the invisible-dragon bug. The full playset showed zero transfer-effect failures even before this patch; the 72 failures were specific to a 3-mod test playset. Kept because it is free and correct.
base = CK3 Naval Combat naval_combat_triggers.txt VERBATIM apart from the changes below

CAUSE: gates special ships on vanilla cultures (norse norwegian swedish danish greek han goryeo) and heritages (heritage_north_germanic heritage_byzantine heritage_chinese). AGOT replace_paths BOTH common/culture/cultures and common/culture/pillars, so none exist. Battle Graphics re-adds the culture definitions at pos 76 but they reference the wiped heritages/languages and still fail to register.
IMPACT: naval_combat_yearly_ai_management evaluates these per character per year - 31,373 'Failed to fetch a valid culture' errors in one 37-minute session, 53% of all script errors.
FIX: the three special-ship triggers become 'always = no'; the stray culture:norse test in naval_combat_can_use_sea_raid_trigger is dropped. All 13 trigger definitions preserved, brace balance 0.
BEHAVIOUR UNCHANGED: every one of these lookups already evaluated false.
P14.1_MISSING_TRIGGER_SHIMS
base = AGOT 00_councillor_triggers.txt blocks for can_be_chancellor_trigger / can_be_steward_trigger / can_be_marshal_trigger, VERBATIM

CAUSE: three mods define these keys - AGOT, Female Knight and Councillor (3616413111, zzzzzz_00_councillor_triggers.txt) and More Traditions v2 + AGoT (2968715458, MTXXX_councillor_triggers.txt). Only one wins. Both submods were built by copying AGOT's block and editing, and BOTH dropped AGOT's own guards: NOT = { has_trait = kingsguard } on all three, plus NOT = { has_trait = maester } on marshal.

FIX: AGOT's blocks verbatim (restoring 4 lore guards) with the single gender-gate line widened into an OR carrying both submods' relaxations - AGOT's faith/doctrine rule, Female Knight's $COURT_OWNER$ = { is_ai = no }, and More Traditions' MTXXX_liege_flouts_council_faith_tradition_trigger + is_ruler = yes.
VERIFIED: 3 keys, brace balance 0, 4 AGOT guards preserved.
DEPENDENCY: needs Female Knight AND More Traditions loaded. Delete this file if either is removed - a dangling trigger reference is the failure mode that caused the kraken GUI bug.
base = AGOT Great Councils' is_human block VERBATIM

CAUSE: DireWolves (pos 50) extends AGOT's is_human with NOT = { has_trait = direwolf }. AGOT Great Councils (pos 83) ships its own otherwise-identical copy that OMITS that line, loads later, and wins - so direwolves count as human for councils, marriage pools and everything else gated on is_human.
FIX: Great Councils' version with DireWolves' direwolf exclusion restored. Same failure class as the invisible-dragon and kraken bugs.
DEPENDENCY: needs DireWolves AND AGOT Great Councils loaded.
